# Whiff

> Whiff is a debt payoff app for people in the United States. Every time money lands in your account (a paycheck, a side gig payout, a friend paying you back, something you sold, birthday money, a refund), Whiff works out a safe amount you can put toward one debt, while your bills stay covered. It also has Whiff Moments, where signed-in people can give toward the debt of members who keep paying. Whiff is coming soon to iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play).

Made by Whiff, Inc., a Delaware corporation. Website: https://whi-ff.com. Contact: contact@whi-ff.com.

## How Whiff works

- **Money in, not just payday.** Any real deposit counts as money in, not only paychecks. Transfers between your own accounts and interest don't count.
- **One safe number.** For each money-in, Whiff suggests one amount to put toward your debt and leaves the rest for you. Suggestions are estimates, not guarantees.
- **Small pieces.** Whiff splits a debt into at most six pieces. Each piece fills with five stamps, about one per time money comes in. Research on debt repayment (Gal & McShane, 2012) found that closing out smaller pieces helps people stay with it.
- **One focus debt.** Whiff recommends one debt to focus on, and you can switch.
- **Little habits.** Whiff can point out one habit to trim a little, for example 20 coffees a month down to 15, with the difference going toward the debt. No budgets, no guilt.
- **Weeks you showed up.** Whiff counts weeks you paid, never weeks you missed.
- **Tiny Whiff.** The app's mascot is Tiny Whiff, a cream plush with a teal striped scarf and a yellow vest.

## Whiff Moments

- Members choose to join. Signed-in helpers see a member's first name, when they joined, their starting and current balance, and their payment history. Never their lender, account numbers, or contact details.
- Gifts go toward the member's debt and can't be cashed out. Gifts aren't charity and aren't tax-deductible.
- No one asks for money. There are no posts asking for help; members keep paying and their progress speaks.
- Helpers must have an account and there are daily giving limits, to prevent card fraud.

## What Whiff is not

Whiff is not a bank, lender, debt-relief or debt-settlement company, credit counselor, or financial advisor. It does not negotiate with creditors. Account connections and payments are handled by third-party partners. Whiff never sees bank passwords.
